UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences, Celigo API tokens, GChat webhook URL, Gmail recipients, and customizable message alert templates

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user owning these settings

email.description: Email address of the authenticated Gappify user

gmailDefaultRecipients.description: Comma-separated default recipient email addresses for incident alerts

gchatMessageTemplate.description: Customizable template for Google Chat card and text alerts

gmailSubjectTemplate.description: Customizable subject template for Gmail incident notification emails

gmailBodyTemplate.description: Customizable body HTML template for Gmail incident notification emails

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last settings update

/user_settings/{userId}.description: Stores user-scoped settings, tokens, GChat hooks, Gmail recipients, and notification templates for cross-device synchronization
